queries.query:
//period=v.windowPeriod
period=1h

battery =
    from(bucket: "raw")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blind1")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "battery_amps")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["location"] == "solar")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: period, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "battery_amps", battery: r._value}))
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "battery"])

shunt =
    from(bucket: "raw")
        |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blind1")
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "shunt_amps")
        |> aggregateWindow(every: period, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with shunt: r._value}))
        |> keep(columns: ["_time", "shunt"])

join(tables: {battery: battery, shunt: shunt}, on: ["_time"])
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
        _time: r._time,
        _value: r.shunt - r.battery,
        _measurement: "blind1",
        _field: "shunt_minus_battery"
    }))
    |> yield(name: "difference")

shunt = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "shunt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shunt_amps" or r._field == "shunt_volts")
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.shunt_amps and exists r.shunt_volts)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.shunt_amps * r.shunt_volts, _field: "batt_w"}))
    |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_field", "_value"])
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

  solar = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_watts")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "solar_w"}))
    |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_field", "_value"])
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

  k = 24.0 / 1000.0        // mean watts over a day -> kWh

  daily = union(tables: [shunt, solar])
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.batt_w and exists r.solar_w)

daily |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time, _value: r.batt_w * k, series: "net (banked +, drawn -)"}))

shunt = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "shunt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shunt_amps" or r._field == "shunt_volts")
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.shunt_amps and exists r.shunt_volts)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.shunt_amps * r.shunt_volts, _field: "batt_w"}))
    |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_field", "_value"])
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

  solar = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1" and r.device == "mppt")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "battery_watts")
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "solar_w"}))
    |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_field", "_value"])
    |> group(columns: ["_field"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

  k = 24.0 / 1000.0        // mean watts over a day -> kWh

  daily = union(tables: [shunt, solar])
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.batt_w and exists r.solar_w)

  generated = daily |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time, _value: r.solar_w * k, series: "generated"}))

  used = daily |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time, _value: (r.solar_w - r.batt_w) * k, series: "used"}))

  net = daily |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time, _value: r.batt_w * k, series: "net (banked +, drawn -)"}))

  union(tables: [generated, used, net])
    |> group(columns: ["series"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> yield(name: "daily energy kWh")

// At least one collection interval, or a zoomed-in panel makes empty windows.
  w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < int(v: 3m) then 3m else v.windowPeriod

  base = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pack_amps" or r._field == "shunt_amps")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "bms" or r.device == "shunt")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_field", "_value"])
    |> group()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.pack_amps and exists r.shunt_amps)

  shunt = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: r.shunt_amps, series: "shunt (whole bank)"}))

  chins = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: r.pack_amps, series: "chins 320"}))

  weize = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: r.shunt_amps - r.pack_amps, series: "weize pair (inferred)"}))

  union(tables: [shunt, chins, weize])
    |> group(columns: ["series"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> yield(name: "amps")

from(bucket: "raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blind1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "shunt_amps")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blind1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pack_amps")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

// At least one collection interval, or a zoomed-in panel makes empty windows.
  w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < int(v: 3m) then 3m else v.windowPeriod

  base = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pack_amps" or r._field == "shunt_amps")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "bms" or r.device == "shunt")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_field", "_value"])
    |> group()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.pack_amps and exists r.shunt_amps)


  chins = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * r.pack_amps / r.shunt_amps,
    series: "chins, actual"}))

  // 320 Ah of 520. Where the chins should sit if both weize are working.
  both_weize = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * 320.0 / 520.0,
    series: "expected, both weize"}))

  // 320 Ah of 420. Where it would sit if one weize had dropped out.
  one_weize = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * 320.0 / 420.0,
    series: "expected, one weize"}))

  union(tables: [chins, both_weize, one_weize])
    |> group(columns: ["series"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> yield(name: "chins share of bank current, percent")

from(bucket: "raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blind1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device"] == "shunt")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "implied_state_of_charge_pct")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

from(bucket: "raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blind1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device"] == "bms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["location"] == "battery")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "state_of_charge_pct")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

// At least one collection interval, or a zoomed-in panel makes empty windows.
  w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < int(v: 3m) then 3m else v.windowPeriod

  base = from(bucket: "raw")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pack_amps" or r._field == "shunt_amps")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "bms" or r.device == "shunt")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_field", "_value"])
    |> group()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.pack_amps and exists r.shunt_amps)


  weize = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * (r.shunt_amps - r.pack_amps) / r.shunt_amps,
    series: "weize, inferred"}))

  // 200 Ah of 520. Where the pair should sit if both are working.
  both_weize = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * 200.0 / 520.0,
    series: "expected, both weize"}))

  // 100 Ah of 420. Where it would sit if only one is carrying load.
  one_weize = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * 100.0 / 420.0,
    series: "expected, one weize"}))

  union(tables: [weize, both_weize, one_weize])
    |> group(columns: ["series"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> yield(name: "weize share of bank current, percent")

from(bucket: "raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "blind1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "remaining_capacity_ah")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device"] == "shunt")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "mean")

  w = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < int(v: 3m) then 3m else v.windowPeriod

  base = from(bucket: "raw")

    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blind1")

    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "bms" or r.device == "shunt")
    |> aggregateWindow(every: w, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> keep(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_time", "_field", "_value"])
    |> group()
    |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.pack_amps and exists r.shunt_amps)


  chins = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * r.pack_amps / r.shunt_amps,
    series: "chins, actual"}))

  // 320 Ah of 520. Where the chins should sit if both weize are working.
  both_weize = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * 320.0 / 520.0,
    series: "expected, both weize"}))

  // 320 Ah of 420. Where it would sit if one weize had dropped out.
  one_weize = base |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _start: r._start, _stop: r._stop, _time: r._time,
    _value: 100.0 * 320.0 / 420.0,
    series: "expected, one weize"}))

  union(tables: [chins, both_weize, one_weize])
    |> group(columns: ["series"])
    |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
    |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> yield(name: "chins share of bank current, percent")
